files.description: Represents a single food item available on the restaurant's menu.

public_variables.description: Primary key, generated automatically.

files.description: Enumeration for the possible states of an order.

public_variables.name: PENDING_PAYMENT
public_variables.description: Order created, awaiting payment.

public_variables.name: CONFIRMED
public_variables.description: Payment received, order is confirmed.

public_variables.name: PREPARING
public_variables.description: Order is being prepared in the kitchen.

public_variables.name: READY_FOR_PICKUP
public_variables.description: Order is ready for pickup.

public_variables.name: COMPLETED
public_variables.description: Order has been picked up/delivered.

public_variables.name: CANCELLED
public_variables.description: Order was cancelled.

files.description: Enumeration for the possible states of a reservation.

public_variables.name: REQUESTED
public_variables.description: Reservation has been requested by the customer.

public_variables.name: CONFIRMED
public_variables.description: Reservation has been confirmed by the restaurant.

public_variables.name: CANCELLED
public_variables.description: Reservation was cancelled.

public_variables.name: COMPLETED
public_variables.description: Guests have completed their dining.
